cues.text: Turn right on the Cataract Trail. Laurel Dell Falls is on your right. The next stretch climbs 20 meters.

cues.title: Barths Creek
cues.text: The path crosses Barths Creek. You will find a bridge on the Cataract Trail. Continue straight on the Cataract Trail.

cues.title: Summit
cues.text: A summit is on your left, about 90 meters off the path. The next stretch climbs 30 meters.

cues.title: Keep right
cues.text: Keep right on the Cataract Trail. The path on the left is not your route.

cues.title: Cataract Creek
cues.text: The path crosses Cataract Creek. After this, the next stretch climbs 20 meters.

cues.title: Cataract Creek
cues.text: The path crosses Cataract Creek. The next 350 meters is mostly level.

cues.title: Cataract Creek
cues.text: You will cross Cataract Creek. There is a bridge on the Cataract Trail.

cues.title: Keep left
cues.text: Keep left on the Cataract Trail. The path on the right is not your route.

cues.title: High point
cues.text: This is the highest point of the walk. You are at about 596 meters.

cues.title: Finish
cues.text: This is the end of the route. The path crosses Cataract Creek.

rows.briefing: This trail is about 1.9 kilometers one way with a total climb of about 80 meters. The steepest sustained climb is 560 meters at about 14% on average. The highest point of the walk is at 692 meters. Enjoy the climb and the descent.

cues.title: Start
cues.text: Start the trail. You will experience about 80 meters of climbing here. This section is 560 meters long and gains 80 meters.

cues.title: High point
cues.text: You have reached the highest point of the walk. This location is at about 692 meters.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right onto the Benstein Trail.

issues.detail: said straight on, the junction goes right

cues.original: Turn right onto the Benstein Trail. Do not go straight ahead to the Lagunitas-Rock Spring Fire Road.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right on the Benstein Trail.

issues.detail: said straight on, the junction goes right

cues.original: Turn right on the Benstein Trail. Do not go straight ahead to the Benstein Spur Trail.

cues.title: Finish
cues.text: This is the end of the route. You have completed the Benstein Trail.
